requirements.summary: Gate the entire app behind Internet Identity login with a dedicated sign-in screen, sign-out, and first-login profile setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users are redirected to a sign-in screen and cannot access app pages.
Authenticated users can sign out.
User-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Create the root app component that wraps all authenticated routes with an AuthGate and routes unauthenticated users to a sign-in screen. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for Internet Identity gating and cache clearing; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an authentication gate that uses the existing immutable useInternetIdentity hook to decide whether to render app content or the sign-in screen; clear React Query cache on logout per the selected "authorization" component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a simple, clean sign-in screen with an Internet Identity login button and basic error handling. Use the selected "authorization" component's login/logout UX recommendations; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook to fetch the current user's profile via the actor and avoid profile-setup modal flash as described by the selected "authorization" component. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a first-login profile setup modal that prompts for a display name when getCallerUserProfile returns null, and saves via saveCallerUserProfile. Follow the selected "authorization" component's profile setup guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement frontend RBAC (Admin/Editor/Viewer) with restricted UI and an Admin role-assignment screen for principals.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend enforces permissions for all write operations (e.g., create/update/delete).
Frontend hides/disabled restricted actions based on role.
Admin can assign/change a user’s role and changes take effect without redeploy.

file_operations.description: Create a hook that reads the caller role from the backend actor and maps it to app roles (Admin/Editor/Viewer) for UI gating. Use the selected "authorization" component's access-control UI guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small wrapper component to show children only if the user meets a required role; otherwise render an access-denied message/screen. Use the selected "authorization" component recommendation for an AccessDeniedScreen; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement an Admin-only UI to assign roles to a principal (paste principal text, pick role Admin/Editor/Viewer, submit to backend). Ensure role changes reflect immediately by invalidating role queries. Use the selected "authorization" component guidance; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create Settings landing page that includes navigation to Access Control (admin-only) and other settings used by modules (e.g., thresholds). Use RBAC wrappers to hide/disable restricted areas. Verify the selected "authorization" component usage instructions before implementing.

Wire Settings routes including an admin-only Access Control route using RequireRole, and ensure restricted actions across pages read from the role hook. Verify the selected "authorization" component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create a responsive app shell and navigation with routes for all MVP sections and clear empty states.
acceptanceCriteria: All listed sections are reachable via navigation.
Layout is mobile-friendly and usable on narrow screens.
Each section has a clear empty state when no data exists.

file_operations.description: Implement a responsive shell with a desktop sidebar and a mobile bottom navigation (or drawer) that links to Dashboard, Brands, Marketing, CRO, Products, Operations, Tasks, Reports, Knowledge, and Settings. Compose (do not modify) existing shadcn/ui components where appropriate (e.g., buttons, dialogs, sheets); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Centralize navigation item definitions (labels, paths, icons if used) to ensure all sections are reachable and consistent across sidebar and mobile nav.
Create the Dashboard route page with a clear empty state when no brands/KPI data exists.
Create the Brands route page shell (list area + empty state); Brand CRUD wiring is handled in REQ-4.
Create the Marketing route page shell with empty state; campaign functionality is handled in REQ-6.
Create the CRO route page shell with empty state; checklist/A-B/notes are handled in REQ-7.
Create the Products route page shell with empty state; SKU management is handled in REQ-8.
Create the Operations route page shell with empty state; ops tracking is handled in REQ-9.
Create the Tasks route page shell with empty state; task manager is handled in REQ-12.
Create the Reports route page shell with empty state; report generation/export is handled in REQ-11.
Create the Knowledge route page shell with empty state; repository functionality is handled in REQ-13.
Define and wire routes for all sections and wrap them with AppShell. Ensure navigation links exist for each route and that unauthenticated users never reach them (AuthGate integration from REQ-1).

requirements.summary: Implement Brand Management UI: list + detail pages with create/edit/archive-delete actions gated by role.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create, view, edit, and archive/delete a brand (subject to RBAC).
Brand detail shows stored key details and goals.
Data persists across refresh/reload.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for listing brand names and fetching brand profiles via the backend actor; include loading/error and empty states.
Create mutations for creating, updating, and deleting brands; invalidate relevant queries after successful writes and handle authorization errors gracefully.

Implement a brand list view with create-brand action (Editor/Admin), search/filter, and an empty state prompting users to add their first brand. Compose (do not modify) existing shadcn/ui components for table/forms where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement brand detail view showing profile fields (products/pricing/margins/suppliers/ad budget and weekly/monthly goals) with edit and delete/archive actions gated by role. Compose (do not modify) shadcn/ui form controls where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a reusable form component for editing BrandProfile fields including suppliers, products/pricing, margin, ad budget, and goals, with validation and a clear empty state for nested lists.
Wire nested brand routes (e.g., brand list + brand detail) under the Brands section and ensure navigation reaches both list and detail pages.

requirements.summary: Build per-brand and cross-brand KPI dashboard UI with weekly/monthly toggles, charts, trends, and missing-data guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: User can select a brand or view an aggregated overview across brands.
At least one chart per KPI category renders from stored data.
User can switch between weekly and monthly views.
If data is missing, UI explains what to add and where.

file_operations.description: Create reusable KPI metric cards (Revenue, Profit, ROAS, CAC, Conversion rate, AOV, Return rate, Shipping cost) with basic trend indicators and consistent styling.
Implement lightweight time-series chart rendering (e.g., SVG-based) that can visualize KPI values for weekly vs monthly views without requiring external integrations.
Add utilities to compute cross-brand aggregates and safe handling of missing/partial KPI data for empty-state guidance.

Implement brand selector (single brand vs all brands), weekly/monthly toggle, KPI cards, and charts. Add explanatory empty states pointing users to Brands (to enter goals/KPIs) and Marketing/Products/Operations (to add supporting data).

requirements.summary: Create Marketing Manager UI for manual campaign logging, sortable comparisons, and underperformer highlighting using configurable thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit campaign performance entries tied to a brand.
User can compare campaigns in a table with sortable columns (at minimum: spend, revenue, ROAS).
Underperforming campaigns are highlighted when they breach thresholds set in Settings.
Creatives/copies can be stored as structured text (e.g., headline/body) plus optional URL references.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for listing, viewing, and sorting campaigns using backend actor capabilities; normalize loading/error states and handle authorization failures.
Create mutations for campaign create/update/delete; invalidate campaign and dashboard queries after writes.

Create a form for campaign entries including campaign name, platform, spend, revenue, ROAS, dates, and structured creative/copy text plus optional URL links. Compose (do not modify) shadcn/ui inputs/dialogs where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a sortable comparison table (spend, revenue, ROAS at minimum) and visually highlight underperformers based on thresholds from Settings. Compose (do not modify) shadcn/ui table components where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement storage and retrieval of configurable marketing thresholds (e.g., min ROAS) for underperformer detection; persist client-side to survive reload (e.g., localStorage) and keep UI consistent.

Implement the Marketing Manager page that ties campaigns to a selected brand, provides create/edit flows, renders the comparison table, and applies underperformer highlighting using configured thresholds.
Add a Settings section for marketing thresholds used to highlight underperforming campaigns, with clear descriptions of how thresholds affect highlighting.

requirements.summary: Implement CRO tools per brand: optimization checklist, A/B test tracker, and searchable UX feedback notes log.
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist items can be created, checked/unchecked, and filtered by status.
A/B tests can be created and tracked through statuses (planned/running/completed).
UX feedback notes support timestamps and are searchable within a brand.

file_operations.description: Create a per-brand CRO storage layer persisted client-side (e.g., localStorage) for checklist items, A/B tests, and UX notes; include search/filter helpers.
Implement checklist UI with create, check/uncheck, and status filtering, including clear empty states.
Implement A/B test tracker UI with hypothesis, variants, dates, and status (planned/running/completed), plus create/edit flows.
Implement UX feedback notes with timestamps and brand-scoped search by text.
Wire brand selection and render checklist, A/B test tracker, and UX notes panels, including empty-state guidance.

requirements.summary: Provide SKU tracking per brand with top/low performers view and inventory alert indicators using configurable thresholds.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit SKU records per brand.
UI can display a “Top / Low performers” view based on stored sales/profitability fields.
Inventory alert state is shown when inventory <= threshold and can be filtered.

file_operations.description: Implement configurable product/inventory thresholds (e.g., low inventory threshold) persisted client-side for alerting and filtering.
Add client-side inventory tracking keyed by brand + SKU (since inventory is not part of the current backend types) and expose helpers to compute alert state and filters.

Create UI to create/edit SKU records per brand by editing the brand's Product list (name, sku, category, price, cost, margin) and saving via brand update. Compose (do not modify) shadcn/ui form components where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement a view that ranks products into Top/Low performers using available stored fields (e.g., margin/profit proxy) and displays results with clear explanations.
Implement inventory alert list/filtering based on client-side inventory state and configured thresholds, with an empty state and guidance.
Wire brand selection and render SKU editor, top/low performers, and inventory alerts; gate editing actions by role (Editor/Admin).
Add settings UI for product/inventory thresholds that drive inventory alert highlighting and filtering.

requirements.summary: Add Operations & Shipping UI per brand: shipping metrics trends/summary and an ops issues log with status filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: User can log shipping metrics per period and view trends/summary per brand.
Ops issues can be created, assigned a status, and filtered (open/closed).
Key metrics (delivery time, RTO, cost per shipment) appear on the brand’s operations page.

file_operations.description: Create client-side persisted storage (e.g., localStorage) for per-brand shipping metrics entries by period and ops issues with status.
Implement UI to log and display delivery time, RTO rate, shipping partner, and cost per shipment, including basic trend visualization and empty-state guidance.
Implement ops issues log UI with create/edit, open/closed status, and filtering.
Wire brand selection and display key shipping metrics and issues log on the Operations page; gate write actions by role (Editor/Admin).

requirements.summary: Implement deterministic, rule-based recommendations and a saveable weekly action plan with explanations and links to underlying data.
acceptanceCriteria: Recommendations are generated deterministically from configured rules (no external AI/LLM calls).
Each recommendation includes a reason (which KPI/threshold triggered it) and the brand/campaign/SKU it relates to.
Weekly action plan can be generated on demand and saved for later review.

file_operations.description: Define deterministic recommendation rules based on stored KPI values and configurable thresholds (e.g., low ROAS, high CAC, low conversion rate), producing structured reasons and references to related entities.
Implement generation and client-side persistence (e.g., localStorage) for weekly action plans; support saving, listing, and re-opening prior plans.
Create UI to render recommendations with explanation text and deep links to relevant sections (brand detail, marketing campaigns, products, operations) to inspect underlying data.
Add a Decision & Strategy section to the Dashboard that generates recommendations on demand and allows generating/saving a weekly action plan.

requirements.summary: Create client-friendly weekly/monthly report views with frontend PDF export via print-to-PDF.
acceptanceCriteria: User can generate a Weekly and Monthly report view with key KPIs, charts, and notable changes.
User can export the report to a PDF file.
Exported PDF contains readable typography and includes date range + brand(s).

file_operations.description: Implement a report renderer that supports weekly/monthly views, includes KPI cards and charts, and shows notable changes (derived from available stored data).
Add an export control that triggers a print-optimized report flow (e.g., opening a print view and calling window.print) to enable user PDF export from the browser.
Implement report generation UI: select brand vs all brands, choose weekly/monthly date range, render the report viewer, and provide a PDF export button.
Add global styles including print styles (@media print) to ensure exported PDFs have readable typography, sensible margins, and hide non-report UI (navigation/chrome) during printing.

requirements.summary: Implement task manager UI with priority, due dates, in-app reminders, filtering, and collaboration notes attached to tasks/brands.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit/complete tasks and filter by brand, status, due date, and priority.
Tasks support freeform notes and optional association to a brand.
Reminders appear as in-app indicators for due/overdue tasks.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for listing tasks and retrieving tasks by brand/upcoming using backend actor capabilities; normalize loading/error states.
Create mutations for create/update/delete tasks; invalidate tasks queries after writes and handle authorization errors gracefully.
Implement client-side persisted collaboration notes per task (since notes/reminders are not present in the current backend types) and expose helpers for editing and displaying notes.

Create a task editor UI that supports description, optional brand association, priority, due date, status transitions, and notes. Compose (do not modify) shadcn/ui dialogs/inputs where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement filtering UI for brand, status, due date, and priority; include a quick view for due/overdue reminders as in-app indicators.
Render task list, filters, create/edit flows, completion actions, and due/overdue reminders; gate write actions by role (Editor/Admin).

requirements.summary: Build a knowledge repository UI with categories, search, rich text (basic formatting), and link attachments.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create/edit/view knowledge entries by category.
User can search entries by title and body text.
Entries persist and are scoped by access permissions (RBAC).

file_operations.description: Implement client-side persisted storage for knowledge entries with categories (best practices, case studies, playbooks, personal notes), indexing for search, and basic access scoping based on the current user role.
Create an editor UI that supports title, category, basic rich text formatting (limited set), and attachment links (URLs). Gate edit/create actions by role (Editor/Admin).
Implement search UI that filters entries by title/body text, plus category filters and an empty state.
Render knowledge list/search, entry view, and create/edit flows, using RBAC to hide/disable restricted actions and to scope what is visible.

requirements.summary: Add in-repo documentation covering architecture, UI flow, data model overview, and an MVP roadmap with phased scope boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Docs include a page/section for architecture (frontend/back-end responsibilities, data flow).
Docs include UI flow/navigation map and primary user journeys (e.g., add brand → add KPIs → dashboard → report).
Docs include a database/data model section listing the core entities and relationships.
Docs include an MVP roadmap phased into at least 2 stages (MVP now vs. later), explicitly calling out deferred items (e.g., live API integrations, PPT export).

file_operations.description: Document high-level system architecture focused on frontend responsibilities, backend interaction patterns, data flow, and security boundaries (authentication/RBAC).
Document UI flow/navigation map and primary user journeys across modules (brand setup, KPI review, marketing logging, reporting, tasks).
Document the core entity model as consumed by the frontend (brands, KPIs, campaigns, tasks, and client-side persisted module data), including relationships and where each is stored.
Document MVP roadmap with at least two phases and explicit deferred scope items (e.g., live integrations, PPT export, realtime features) aligned to requested modules.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive, neutral analytics-style visual theme (no blue/purple) with consistent typography, spacing, and reusable UI patterns for cards/tables/charts.
acceptanceCriteria: All main pages share consistent spacing, typography, and component styling.
Theme is applied consistently to navigation, headings, cards, tables, and empty states.
Design remains accessible (reasonable contrast, readable text on mobile).

file_operations.description: Define global design tokens (CSS variables) for a neutral palette (charcoal/off-white) with a sage/teal accent (non-blue/purple), plus typography scale defaults and accessible contrast.
Adjust Tailwind theme extension (if needed) to align with the new neutral palette tokens and ensure consistent styling for cards, tables, navigation, and chart colors.
Create a reusable empty state component used across pages to keep messaging and layout consistent.
Create a reusable page header (title, description, actions) to standardize layout across modules.

Create a reusable card wrapper for metrics panels and content sections to ensure consistent spacing and styling (compose with existing shadcn/ui primitives where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing).
Apply the theme consistently to navigation elements (sidebar/mobile nav), headings, and overall spacing to achieve a clean, mobile-friendly layout.
